new.action: Prompt favorites early in the session

new.statement: More novel concepts hold higher Top Trending positions among games of similar age

new.statement: Throw-for-luck clones with a fresh creature or prop theme (friend, clowns, Chiikawas, zombies, wake-an-animal, cast-for-fish) each reach Up-and-Coming or Top Trending within weeks and show unusually high favorites per visit and like ratios of 92 to 99%
new.action: Re-skin throw-for-luck with a fresh theme
new.rationale: 2026-11-27: Throw a Friend for Monsters (97% likes, 280K favorites on 4.9M visits), Throw Food For Clowns (92%, 287K on 3.9M), Throw Brains For Zombies (99%), Throw Food for Chiikawas (98%) and Wake Up An Animal (93%) are all on the breakout charts. Confirm if new clones keep entering at similar like ratios; refute if they stop appearing or fall within a week. Extends H-x-045.

new.statement: Realistic-physics titles are spreading from ragdolls to new objects: soft-body cars (Crash Engine), planes (Realistic Plane Crashing, Pleb's Plane Crash Sandbox), wall climbing and strand-physics hair all sit on the breakout charts
new.action: Apply realistic physics to a new object
new.rationale: 2026-11-27 profiles: Crash Engine is Up-and-Coming #3 at 10 days; two plane-crash games and a climbing and a hair game entered Up-and-Coming. Sandbox physics earns little per player (see H-x-043), so confirm only if these hold Top Earning positions; refute if they fade within two weeks as ragdolls did.

new.statement: Hands-on job simulations with a filming, judging or rating hook (Barber Empire 'go viral', Barber Showdown judge scores, Slay or Nay AI judges) rank higher on Up-and-Coming than plain tycoon loops
new.action: Add a rating or filming hook to job sims
new.rationale: 2026-11-27: Barber Empire is Up-and-Coming #4 and Top Trending #6 at 27 days, while Barber Showdown (#83) and Slay or Nay (Top Trending only) sit lower. Needs more games with and without a hook before confidence rises.

new.statement: Unofficial lookalikes of established IP (Sonic, Naruto, Chiikawa, Peppa Pig, Geometry Dash) keep placing on the breakout charts despite takedown risk
new.rationale: 2026-11-27: +1 Hedgehog Evolve (Top Trending #45), +1 Jutsu Evolution (Up-and-Coming #51), Throw Food for Chiikawas (#86), Peppa's House (Most Popular #96), Geometry Dash 2.2 (Up-and-Coming #88). Descriptive only; would need survival time of such games versus original-IP games to say anything.

qualitative_updates.note: Five more throw-for-luck variants (Friend, Clowns, Chiikawas, Zombies, Wake Up An Animal) are on Top Trending or Up-and-Coming today.
Roblox's own Thanksgiving event experience The Great Build is Up-and-Coming #1 and Top Trending #1 at 3 days old with 22.4M visits: platform-run events can dominate the breakout charts.
Thanksgiving hooks appear on The Great Build (Nov 25-30) and in Freekick Duel's Thanksgiving pack; both are updating this week.

Seven or more ragdoll sandboxes (Superpower Ragdoll, Ragdoll Samurai, SCP Ragdoll, Ragdoll Factory, Impact Ragdoll, Stupid Ragdolls) are still entering Up-and-Coming and Top Trending, but the oldest ones are slipping.
